Jigsaw Homes Group named as strategic partner by Homes England
Jigsaw Funding plc is a wholly owned subsidiary of Jigsaw Homes Group Limited ("Jigsaw or the Group").
Jigsaw Homes Group has been awarded £249.5 million in government grant funding to help deliver 1,990 new social and affordable homes across the North West and East Midlands.

The housing provider is among 33 strategic partners confirmed by Homes England to help deliver the government's new £39 billion Social and Affordable Homes Programme (SAHP), the largest investment in social and affordable housing in a generation. Details of the publication can be found here:
